given: An isolated Personal Agent store, scheduler, and stable pa-cli cron capability
when: The main Agent creates, verifies, and later triggers a recurring reminder
acceptance: The schedules capability is registered as implemented and the Personal Agent Skill routes reminder requests through pa-cli cron

The desktop exposes scheduled plans only as the task module's Automation subview; /app/automations and /app/schedules redirect to /app/workers/schedules and no standalone automation product or editable rule engine remains
A scheduled task persists its cron expression, IANA timezone, prompt, enabled state and next run, and the Agent verifies mutations by listing persisted schedules
Schedules reject intervals shorter than fifteen minutes
A due schedule creates a normal local task and records its execution without depending on Cloud
Built-in mail scanning may directly create a normal task after protection checks but does not create an automation rule, run, template, or automation Activity
Calendar records and follow-up history are Space-isolated and main-Agent capability-bound; updates require the current revision and do not create cron rules or send messages to participants
Calendar stores participants and offset-aware start/end times with an IANA display timezone, filters overlapping ranges, and exposes read-only authenticated UI history

Desktop and mobile calendar default to an upcoming view without a fixed future horizon; the scoped query excludes completed and cancelled entries and reports nearest future and ongoing entries independently of pagination, while preserving explicit day, week and poster link ranges and stating the next date and timezone before imagery
